title: Problems it solves
lead: Today, every way of talking to TYPO3 is built separately. The Action API replaces these islands with one consistent model.

title: The concept: actions
lead: An action is a public method of a service, marked with the `#[AsAction]` attribute. Its signature is the contract: TYPO3 derives everything else from it, once, when the dependency injection container is compiled.

title: Security model
